courier-relay/protocols/current:
Purpose: durable Courier Relay receipt protocol agreement for count and summary requests.

Applicability: every valid request, regardless of receipt dates; omitted protocol uses the current protocol. Protocol values are strings.

Current protocol: 2, approved by the integration owner in issue trial-qfv. A delivery identity is the pair (account_id, delivery_id), so the same delivery_id under different accounts is distinct. Accept exactly one receipt per identity: choose the latest occurred_at UTC instant; if instants are equal, choose the smallest record_id by Unicode code-point order. Accepted receipts retain all original fields, timestamp spelling, and payload, and are ordered by original input position. duplicate_count is all nonaccepted receipts.

Historical supported protocol: 1, from vendor/protocol-1.md and retained by trial-qfv. A delivery identity is delivery_id alone across accounts. Choose the earliest occurred_at UTC instant; equal instants use the smallest record_id by Unicode code-point order. Protocol 1 remains selectable after protocol 2 becomes current.

Timestamp comparison is by UTC instant for RFC3339 timestamps with seconds, no fractional seconds, and either Z or an explicit numeric offset. Responses for count and summary contain exactly protocol, accepted_count, and duplicate_count and report the actual protocol used. Evidence: issue trial-qfv approval and implementation validation with unittest smoke, all supplied public suites, and custom cross-account, UTC-offset, tie-break, empty-set, ping, and unknown-command checks performed during this work.
